title: SeT-Diff：面向HPC遥测和时间序列的语义基础模型
summary: SeT-Diff是首个面向计算节点遥测和时间序列的基础模型，采用扩散方法，基于每个传感器的语义描述进行条件生成，解耦系统动态与数据集结构。在真实超算数据集上，重建任务MAE为0.0470，具备零样本排列稳定性，可执行数据插补、预测和虚拟传感，热推断MAE为0.033，成为HPC系统有效的数据驱动数字孪生。
summary_en: SeT-Diff is the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series, using a diffusion-based approach conditioned on each sensor's semantic description. It achieves 0.0470 MAE on reconstruction, zero-shot permutation stability, and performs imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing (0.033 MAE on thermal inference), serving as an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.
